mechanics.claim: Splinters are gained from landing two separate instances of ability damage on the same enemy champion within the mark duration.
mechanics.quote: Dealing two instances of {{tip|champion ability|ability}} damage to an enemy champion within 4 seconds grants {{as|Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}}

mechanics.claim: This proc cannot trigger again on the same target for a short cooldown afterward (exact duration not stated in the wiki text).
mechanics.quote: This cannot occur on the same target more than once every few seconds.

mechanics.claim: Collecting a Splinter of Wrath from an enemy restores mana, with a short travel delay before it reaches Syndra.
mechanics.quote: Collecting a {{as|Splinter of Wrath|buzzword}} from an enemy restores {{sti|{{As|mana}}}} for '''Syndra'''.

mechanics.claim: Syndra can still collect Splinters (and gain their mana restore) from enemies while already at the 120-stack cap, even though these do not add further stacks.
mechanics.quote: '''''Syndra''' can collect {{as|Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}} from enemies even if she is at maximum stacks. These {{as|Splinters|buzzword}} do not grant any stacks, but will still restore {{as|mana}} for '''Syndra'''.''

mechanics.claim: At the maximum 120 Splinters of Wrath, Syndra permanently gains bonus ability power (Transcendence).
mechanics.quote: At {{as|120 Splinters of Wrath|buzzword}}, '''Syndra''' achieves ''Transcendence'', increasing her {{sti|{{as|ability power}}}} by 15%.
